name: Ming-3.0-audio (flash 126B-A6.5B and tiny 9.3B-A2.7B)
purpose: Native audio-language model: takes audio plus a text instruction and returns text, or text with optional synthesized speech (Talker); covers speech recognition, spoken question answering, audio understanding and reasoning (card).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: LICENSE of the GitHub code repository read (MIT, Copyright 2025 inclusionAI); the HF cards state MIT for the weights. The HF repos have no LICENSE file of their own (raw/main/LICENSE returns 404). The talker folder ships a lid.176 language-ID file with its own license file (lid.176.LICENSE.md, not read).

architecture.kind: audio encoder (Whisper-style, 32 layers, width 1280) plus projector plus MoE language backbone with linear-attention (KDA) and MLA layers, optional Talker for speech output (config.json: model_type bailing_moe_v3_audio)
architecture.attention: MLA (kv_lora_rank 512) mixed with KDA linear attention, layer_group_size 6 (flash config); 1 MTP layer in config
architecture.drafter: config has num_nextn_predict_layers 1; a community DFlash drafter repo exists (wilsonzheng0327/Ming-3.0-audio-flash-dflash, not read)

variants.notes: 126B total / 6.5B active (card); 256.37 GB safetensors plus 3.01 GB talker. Reference serving profile: four 80 GB H800 GPUs (card)
9.3B total / 2.7B active (card); 17.74 GB safetensors plus 3.01 GB talker; text config: 24 layers, hidden 1536, 128 experts, 8 active

variants.format: GGUF Q4_K (Thinker experts; Q8_0 output head)
variants.notes: single GGUF with audio encoder, Thinker, Talker, VAE and speaker encoder; Q8_0 13.67 GB, BF16 20.18 GB; runs in audio.cpp (CUDA backend in the card examples); MIT per card
5.77 GB weights plus 3.0 GB talker; 8bit 12.71 GB
82.75 GB safetensors plus 3.01 GB talker; third-party quantization, not evaluated here

pc-12gb.notes: 9.97 GB file against about 9.6 GB VRAM budget; the audio.cpp card measured 11.6 GB peak VRAM in fully resident mode on CUDA, so expert offload to RAM would be needed. Flash: no.

pc-16gb.notes: 11.6 GB peak VRAM reported by the audio.cpp card (CUDA, resident mode) against about 13.6 GB budget. Flash: no (NVFP4 85.76 GB).

pc-32gb.notes: Flash: no; the only quantization found, NVFP4 85.76 GB, exceeds the roughly 80 GB budget.

mac-16-24gb.notes: 8.77 GB against about 12 GB GPU share. Flash: no.

mac-64gb+.notes: Flash: no (85.76 GB NVFP4 against about 52 GB GPU share); a 64 GB Mac cannot hold it, a larger Mac might (not checked).

engine_support.notes: Backbone is a Ling-style MoE with KDA linear attention and MLA, the same family as ming-3.0-tts-tiny.

benchmarks.name: Big Bench Audio (Artificial Analysis speech reasoning)
benchmarks.variant: flash, non-thinking mode (README of the code repository)
benchmarks.harness: Artificial Analysis leaderboard as cited by the card

strengths: One model for ASR, audio understanding, audio reasoning and optional speech reply, with voice cloning from a reference voice (card)
Tiny variant has a single-file GGUF with every component and a published speed figure
weaknesses: Primary languages Chinese and English only; German is not named
Flash needs a multi-GPU node by the vendor's own reference profile
ASR, audio-intelligence and text benchmark tables on the cards are images; only the Big Bench Audio number is given as text
soft.behavior: The validated ASR prompt asks for the language label and the transcription separated by a tab; run with a no-repeat n-gram size of 10 in the card example.
soft.maturity: inclusionAI (Ant Group); repos last modified 2026-11-18; several community quantizations within weeks.

tona_fit.reason: Tiny (2.7B active, MIT, one GGUF with ASR plus speech reply) is the first open audio-to-audio model that fits a 16 GB card, but the languages are Chinese and English only, so German users get no benefit; flash does not fit any hardware class. Revisit if German or other languages are added, or as a source for a Ling-MoE/KDA backend that also serves ming-3.0-tts-tiny.

Speed of the tiny GGUF on AMD/ROCm or Metal: audio.cpp card gives CUDA numbers only (real-time factor 0.024 for Q4_K in resident mode, vendor-of-the-port figure)
Purpose and architecture rationale: the cards state no design reasons beyond the feature list
Whether the DFlash drafter for flash is useful: community repo not read
